lines.text: The queen of Sheba came to test Solomon with difficult questions, and he answered all of them.
She arrived in Jerusalem with a large caravan of camels carrying spices, silver, and precious stones.
She blessed the LORD, then gave the king 120 talents of gold, spices, and precious stones.
Solomon made almug wood from Ophir into steps for the house of the LORD and lyres for the priests.
Solomon gathered 1,400 chariots and 12,000 horses, and his horses were imported from Egypt and Kue.
